_note: Monthly costs that Infracost cannot price from this repo's HCL, at eu-west-1 list prices. scripts/infracost.sh adds this list to the Infracost total so the report has no silent gaps. Every figure is traceable to docs/infracost.md; revisit it when the stack around it changes.

items.name: monitoring: ECS collector task (every 2 min, ~45 s, 0.25 vCPU / 0.5 GB)
items.why: aws_ecs_task_definition with no aws_ecs_service: EventBridge starts it, so Infracost has no service to price.

items.name: monitoring: SQL Server metrics task (hourly, ~30 s)
items.why: Same: scheduled task definition, no service.

items.name: monitoring: CUR budget task (daily, ~60 s)
items.why: Same: scheduled task definition, no service.

items.name: monitoring: monthly report task (1 run/month, ~90 s)
items.why: Same: scheduled task definition, no service. Rounds to zero.

items.name: monitoring: Cloud Map private namespace (Route53 private hosted zone)
items.why: aws_service_discovery_private_dns_namespace is not in Infracost's price list. AWS bills the private zone it creates at $0.50/month; ECS service-discovery registrations themselves are free.

items.name: monitoring: Cloud Map DNS lookups (~250k queries/month)
items.why: Private-zone DNS queries are billed at $0.40/million (first billion). Prometheus scrapes 5 targets over 10 s TTLs.

items.name: prod + dev: in-use public IPv4 addresses (dev Elastic IP, NAT gateway EIP, ALB)
items.why: 3 addresses x $0.005/hour x 730 h. Infracost's aws_eip only charges the ElasticIP:IdleAddress usage type, so attached addresses and the ALB's address show as free.

items.name: prod: internet egress (~50 GB/month through the ALB)
items.why: Data transfer out is billed per GB by the account, not by a Terraform resource: $0.09/GB in eu-west-1 after the 100 GB free tier.

items.name: dev: Amplify — 2 apps (build minutes + served GB)
items.why: Free tier covers 1,000 build minutes and 15 GB served per month; ~$5/month once either is exceeded. aws_amplify_app is not in Infracost's price list.

items.name: dev: EventBridge Scheduler (2 schedules, ~60 invocations/month)
items.why: aws_scheduler_schedule is not priced by Infracost; $1 per million invocations makes this zero at this volume.

items.name: monitoring: SES (domain identity, DKIM records, ~1 report mail/month)
items.why: aws_ses_domain_identity is not priced by Infracost; domain verification is free and the first 3,000 messages/month cost $0.

items.name: prod: SNS topic for the SQL Server disk alarm (e-mail subscription)
items.why: aws_sns_topic is priced per request; a handful of publishes a month is inside the free tier.

items.name: monitoring: EventBridge rules (4) and the CUR report definition
items.why: aws_cloudwatch_event_rule and aws_cur_report_definition are not priced by Infracost; both are free, the Parquet they write is charged as S3 storage (usage file).

items.name: monitoring + prod: KMS API requests beyond the free tier
items.why: Keys themselves are priced ($1/month each, in the Infracost total); the request charge is $0.03 per 10,000 and this stack stays inside the free tier.

items.name: dev: t3.medium CPU credits
items.why: The host can burst above baseline; the model assumes it does not. ~$0.05 per vCPU-hour if it does.
